segments.text: Hello, Uncle.

Yes, yes.
So, in general, you call my mother and ask her.

If you have to do a lot of work at the same time, how do you track all the work and how do you coordinate your phone calls?
We have a team of around 10 people, and we keep track of all the phone calls.
There are some people who say it's okay to stop after 2 days.

We will do it quickly for those people.

Okay.
Okay. So you will find out what the urgency is and do it.
Yes, we will keep doing it.
You don't do everything yourself, right?
There are many people under you.
How do you decide who should be sent for what work?
We decide who can do what and send them accordingly.
Some people do it as a senior, some people do it as a junior.
We send one person to do the main work and one person to do the minor work.
If you want to take someone new, how do you do it?
If you want to take someone new, how do you do it?
If I am doing it as a senior, I will keep them with me.
I will keep them with good people.
After they learn for 1-2 years, we will send them out.
Okay, I understood.
If someone calls you and says they have a problem, what do you do?
When we ask them to come, we know from their side, what kind of questions they ask, we know that.
When you ask them what kind of questions they ask, do you get frustrated? Can you tell us?
Like getting irritated.
There is no such thing as getting irritated at all.
